parameters.query:
INSERT INTO user_states (user_id, current_mode) 
VALUES ($1, $2) 
ON CONFLICT (user_id) 
DO UPDATE SET current_mode = $2, 
  last_updated = NOW();

assignments.name: ingredientsGreeting
assignments.value:
=🌿 *Ingredient Mode Active*

You can now manage your raw stock and costs. I'll automatically calculate your weighted average costs as you buy!

*Available Commands:*
🛒 **Buy:** `bought 5kg Flour for 10`
📉 **Use:** `used 500g Flour`
💰 **Price:** `Flour price is now 2.50`
📊 **Status:** `status of Flour`
📋 **Inventory:** `list inventory`
🗑️ **Delete:** `delete Flour`

Type *exit* to return to the main menu.

assignments.name: productsGreeting
assignments.value:
=📦 *Product Mode Active*

Manage your shop's menu. You can add items with photos, update prices, or remove products.

*Available Commands:*
➕ **Add:** `Add Vanilla Cake $30`
(Attach a photo to the message to set the product image!)
🔄 **Update:** `Update Carrot Cake $35`
📋 **List:** `list products`
🗑️ **Delete:** `Delete Chocolate Cake`

Type *exit* to return to the main menu.

assignments.name: recipesGreeting
assignments.value:
=👩‍🍳 *Recipe & Costing Mode Active*

Turn your raw ingredients into profitable products. Manage your formulas and track your margins in real-time.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ **Build your Recipe:**
• **Create:** `create recipe "Carrot Cake" yields 1 unit`
• **Add:** `add 200g Flour to "Carrot Cake"`
• **Steps:** `set instructions for "Carrot Cake": Bake at 180°C...`

📊 **Analysis & Action:**
• **Cost:** `how much does "Carrot Cake" cost?`
• **Details:** `what is in the "Carrot Cake"?`
• **Production:** `cooked 2 "Carrot Cake"` _(Auto-subtracts stock!)_
• **List:** `show all recipes`

🗑️ **Modify:**
• `remove "Flour" from "Carrot Cake"`
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Type *exit* to return to the main menu.
